name: Ore Crusher
description: Heavy dual-toothed rotary crushing machine with vibro-hopper and articulated discharge conveyor for sizing raw planetary ores.
scientific_principle: Mechanical comminution via counter-rotating hardened tungsten-carbide teeth reduce bulk overburden into uniform <10mm aggregate.

name: Mineral Separator
description: Cross-belt magnetic and density separator extracting paramagnetic minerals from non-metallic tailings.
scientific_principle: High-gradient neodymium magnetic array combined with acoustic fluidization splits ferrosilicates from inert gangue.

name: Ore Smelting Furnace
description: Induction vacuum smelting furnace featuring high-temperature ceramic crucible, thermal heat radiators, and slag drain.
scientific_principle: High-frequency RF electromagnetic induction heating to 1850K reduces metal oxides under low-pressure reducing atmosphere.

name: Regolith Processor
description: Trommel screen classification unit with electrostatic dust precipitators and magnetic fraction separation.
scientific_principle: Rotary trommel particle sizing coupled with electrostatic precipitators isolates respirable silica fines and valuable ilmenite fractions.

name: Ice Melting Machine
description: Sealed thermal extraction autoclave featuring ceramic heating coils, vacuum seal lid, and slurry pump outlet.
scientific_principle: Conductive resistance heaters liquefy cryospheric volatile ice under controlled hyperbaric pressure to prevent sublimation loss.

name: Water Purification Unit
description: Multi-stage reverse osmosis filtration rack equipped with UV-C sterilizers and catalytic perchlorate neutralizers.
scientific_principle: High-pressure ceramic membrane osmosis removes heavy metals, salts, and perchlorate anions followed by germicidal ultraviolet disinfection.

name: Water Electrolysis Machine
description: Proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzer splitting deionized water into pure pressurized gaseous H2 and O2 streams.
scientific_principle: 2 H2O(l) + electrical energy -> 2 H2(g) + O2(g) across solid polymer electrolyte membranes operating at 35 bar.

name: Water Storage & Pumping Station
description: Pressurized manifold reservoir station with dual redundant centrifugal boost pumps, surge damping vessels, and telemetry.
scientific_principle: Hydrostatic accumulation and variable-frequency displacement pumping maintains 6.0 bar ring-main habitat hydraulic pressure.

name: Oxygen Generator
description: Solid oxide electrolysis cell (MOXIE-style) generating breathable O2 from planetary atmospheric carbon dioxide.
scientific_principle: Zirconia ceramic electrolyte catalytic cracking splits CO2 into carbon monoxide and oxygen ions at 800C.

name: Gas Compressor
description: Multi-stage reciprocating gas compressor with interstage glycol coolers and dynamic balance flywheels.
scientific_principle: Polytropic multi-stage piston compression raises gas pressure from ambient 0.006 bar to 300 bar for cryogenic containment.

name: CO2 Processor
description: Sabatier methanation catalytic reactor converting habitat respiratory exhaled CO2 and hydrogen into rocket fuel and water.
scientific_principle: Sabatier catalytic reaction: CO2 + 4 H2 -> CH4 + 2 H2O at 400C over ruthenium-alumina catalysts.

name: Gas Storage & Distribution System
description: Quad cryogenic pressure vessel array with automated manifold regulators, relief valves, and distribution meters.
scientific_principle: Cryogenic vacuum-jacketed Dewar containment prevents boil-off loss with electro-pneumatic pressure balancing.

name: Industrial Fabricator
description: Automated selective laser sintering and robotic assembly cell with 5-axis articulated head and toolchanger.
scientific_principle: Directed energy deposition (DED) additive manufacturing builds functional mechanical parts directly from metal powders.

name: Metal Refining Station
description: Electrolytic refining vat with zone-refining thermal heaters for producing 99.99% ultra-pure metallurgy.
scientific_principle: Electro-refining and zone melting isolates interstitial impurities and refines crystalline grain boundaries for structural alloys.

name: Industrial Battery Storage Unit
description: Solid-state lithium-sulfur energy reservoir rack with liquid dielectric immersion cooling and active fire suppression.
scientific_principle: Solid-state electrolyte intercalation chemistry provides 850 Wh/kg specific energy with zero thermal runaway propagation.

name: Automated Conveyor System
description: Heavy-duty modular link-belt transport conveyor with optical item sorting sensors and transfer deflectors.
scientific_principle: Direct-drive brushless motor driven roller flight conveyor with optoelectronic item tracking facilitates zero-loss material transfer.
